parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional, any unique string (a UUID is good), up to 255 characters. Send the same key when you retry: a repeat returns what the first request made (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of making it twice. The same key with a different request is 422. Keys last 24 hours, per member.

post.summary: Email yourself a test from this address (Admin)
Email the address a one-time code to check it forwards to CeDesk (Admin)
post.description: The email comes from the address itself, to itself. When it comes back in (forwarding, or the mailbox CeDesk reads), `forwarding_verified` turns true; it never makes a ticket. 409 when the last check was sent under a minute ago.

post.summary: Check the address's domain for SPF, DKIM and DMARC now (Admin)
post.description: Each part is ok, missing, wrong, not_checked (DKIM without a selector) or error (DNS didn't answer: try again), with a note saying what to do. Kept on the address (`dns`). Takes up to a few seconds.

get.summary: Admin: emails that could not be sent after every retry

post.summary: Admin: send a failed email again
post.description: It goes back in the queue (tries from zero) and the worker sends it within seconds; its ticket gets a line saying who did it. 404 if it isn't failed or can't be retried (account emails).

post.summary: A mail service delivers one incoming email (token required)

put.summary: Admin: change the first-reply and resolve targets per priority
put.description: Only the priorities sent change. The first reply can't be due after the resolution (422). Every open ticket's SLA is worked out again.

put.summary: Admin: save the ordered SLA policies (on/off, order, conditions, targets)
put.description: Send the whole list. 422 when a name repeats, a target is out of range, the last policy has a condition or is off, or another policy matches every ticket.

put.summary: Admin: business hours (days, hours, time zone) or 24/7
put.description: Hours are the same each working day, closing after opening (no overnight shifts). 422 for an unknown time zone.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Added under every reply from this address. Placeholders such as {{agent.name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Replies come from it when the customer wrote elsewhere. The first address is always the default.

forwarding_verified.title: Forwarding Verified
forwarding_verified.description: A forwarding-check email came back in: emails to it reach CeDesk.

forwarding_check_sent_at.title: Forwarding Check Sent At

forwarding_check_email.title: Forwarding Check Email
forwarding_check_email.description: The last check email: pending (queued or retrying), sent, or failed (the mail service refused it, e.g. the domain isn't verified there; see `forwarding_check_error`). null: none sent.

forwarding_check_error.title: Forwarding Check Error
forwarding_check_error.description: Why the last check email failed or is being retried.

forward_to.title: Forward To
forward_to.description: Where to forward this address to (set by the server); null: not needed or not set up (e.g. CeDesk reads the mailbox itself).

dns.description: The last DNS check; null: never checked.

anyOf.description: Shown as the sender, e.g. 'Acme Support'.
Added under every reply from this address. Placeholders such as {{agent.name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

dkim_selector.title: Dkim Selector
dkim_selector.description: Where the mail service keeps the DKIM key (s1, google, ...). "" clears.

can_retry.title: Can Retry

key.title: Key
key.description: Stored on tickets: a-z, 0-9 and _, starting with a letter.

message.title: Message
message.description: Its first 60 characters become the subject.

website.title: Website
website.description: Honeypot: render it hidden (off-screen, `tabindex=-1`, `autocomplete="off"`) and always send it empty. Filled in: nothing is made.

types.title: Types
types.description: Show a type picker when there are any.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the next page.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "reply", "text": "Hi {{customer.first_name}}, ..."} (placeholders are filled when it runs); {"kind": "note", "text": "..."}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "resolved"}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "low"}; {"kind": "set_type", "type_id": "...", "only_if_empty": false} (fields the new type lacks are cleared); {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."} (re-routes the ticket); {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "refund"}. At most one reply and one note.

ids.title: Ids

position.title: Position
position.description: The order in the Macros menu, lowest first.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: What to fix, e.g. the team it sets was deleted. Empty when fine.

anyOf.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "reply", "text": "Hi {{customer.first_name}}, ..."} (placeholders are filled when it runs); {"kind": "note", "text": "..."}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "resolved"}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "low"}; {"kind": "set_type", "type_id": "...", "only_if_empty": false} (fields the new type lacks are cleared); {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."} (re-routes the ticket); {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "refund"}. At most one reply and one note.

next_after.title: Next After

scan_status.description: not_scanned, clean, infected, or scan_failed (could not be checked).

kind.description: reply: to the customer. note: team only.

attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids
attachment_ids.description: Files to send with it: upload each to the ticket first (POST /tickets/{id}/attachments), then list their ids here. Only your own files not sent yet. With files, `body` may be empty.

email.title: Email

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files sent with it (by the agent, or in the customer's email).

delivery.title: Delivery

message.title: Message
message.description: What happened. Its first 60 characters become the subject.

fields.title: Fields

policies.title: Policies

channels.title: Channels

url.title: Url
url.description: Opens the file without signing in, until `expires_at`.

scan_status.description: infected / scan_failed: show as blocked, no link.

from_customer.title: From Customer

allowed_domains.description: Empty: anyone can sign in. Otherwise only these email domains (and their subdomains), e.g. ["acme.com"].

csat_survey.title: Csat Survey
csat_survey.description: Email a 1-5 survey when a ticket is resolved.

web_form.title: Web Form
web_form.description: The public contact form (`/public/{workspace}/form`) is open. Off: 404.

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on portal routes.

csat.description: The customer's rating. Offer 1-5 stars when `status` is resolved.

messages.title: Messages

older_messages_cursor.title: Older Messages Cursor

body.description: Markdown. Render it without raw HTML.

rating.description: Already rated: show it, allow a change.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: created: a new ticket; added / rules_ran / reopened / thanked: on an existing ticket; verification: a support address's forwarding check came back (no ticket); the rest: ignored on purpose.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every ticket type id, in the new order.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 to 128 characters. Give it to the member; they can change it later.

token.title: Token

cap_chat.title: Cap Chat
cap_chat.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

cap_messaging.title: Cap Messaging
cap_messaging.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

event.description: created: a new ticket. customer_replied: the customer wrote on an Open or Pending ticket. sla_breached: an open ticket's SLA clock ran out (checked once a minute; once per clock). Agent edits never run rules.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: All must match. Each is one of: {"kind": "text_contains_any", "words": ["refund"]} (subject and customer messages, any case); {"kind": "channel_in", "channels": ["email"]}; {"kind": "to_address_contains", "text": "billing@"}; {"kind": "status_in", "statuses": ["pending"]}; {"kind": "sentiment_in", "sentiments": ["negative"]}; {"kind": "sla_in", "states": ["breached"]} (the SLA pill's clock: on_track, close, breached, met; not on created).

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Run in order. Each is one of: {"kind": "set_type", "type_id": "...", "only_if_empty": false}; {"kind": "set_team", "team_id": "..."}; {"kind": "set_priority", "priority": "high", "keep_urgent": true}; {"kind": "set_status", "status": "open"}; {"kind": "add_tag", "tag": "upset"}.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every rule id, in the new order.

position.title: Position
position.description: Rules run in this order, lowest first.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: What to fix, e.g. the team it sets was deleted. Empty when fine.

anyOf.description: created: a new ticket. customer_replied: the customer wrote on an Open or Pending ticket. sla_breached: an open ticket's SLA clock ran out (checked once a minute; once per clock). Agent edits never run rules.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: What the agent types after `/`, e.g. `refund`. Stored lower-case.

body.title: Body
body.description: The text. Placeholders such as {{customer.first_name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Without the slash: `refund` is typed as `/refund`.

source.title: Source
source.description: default (came with the workspace), manual, calendly, or an import source such as intercom.

anyOf.description: What the agent types after `/`, e.g. `refund`. Stored lower-case.
The text. Placeholders such as {{customer.first_name}} are filled when the reply is sent.

Sentiment.title: Sentiment
Sentiment.description: Set by triage (keyword rules, Phase 2) or the Cevanos handover.

code.title: Code
code.description: The 6 digits from the email (spaces or a dash are fine).

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once.

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: The reply or resolution; null while running.

state.title: State
state.description: close: under 25% of the target left. breached stays after the reply. met: done in time.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: The SLA policy that matched; null: priority targets.

current.title: Current
current.description: The clock the pill shows: first reply until it is replied, then resolve.

state.title: State
state.description: The current clock's state, for the pill.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Outside business hours (or a holiday) and still running. Pending does not pause.

SlaOut.title: SlaOut
SlaOut.description: The ticket's SLA, worked out when it is read (W13).

Sort.title: Sort

open_breaching.title: Open Breaching
open_breaching.description: Open or Pending now and past their SLA time.

avg_first_response_minutes.title: Avg First Response Minutes
avg_first_response_minutes.description: Tickets created in the period: creation to the first agent reply.

avg_resolution_minutes.title: Avg Resolution Minutes
avg_resolution_minutes.description: Tickets resolved in the period: creation to resolution.

first_reply_sla_met_percent.title: First Reply Sla Met Percent
first_reply_sla_met_percent.description: Of the tickets created in the period whose first-reply clock stopped or ran out, the share answered in time (business hours, as the SLA pill).

first_reply_sla_measured.title: First Reply Sla Measured
first_reply_sla_measured.description: How many tickets that % is out of.

reads_as.title: Reads As
reads_as.description: The sentence under the row, e.g. 'Urgent tickets get ...'

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: true: never changed by an Admin.

sent_to.title: Sent To
sent_to.description: Your own address; the email is queued, not yet sent.

counts.description: Per status, ignoring the other filters (for the tabs).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same filters and sort, for the next page. null on the last page.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: false: a handover waiting for an agent to accept it.

csat.description: The customer's rating of this ticket, if any.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The latest 50 messages, oldest to newest.

older_messages_cursor.title: Older Messages Cursor
older_messages_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to GET /tickets/{id}/messages for older messages; null when every message is shown.

TicketPatch.title: TicketPatch
TicketPatch.description: Send only what changes. `null` clears type, team, assignee or one field.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: false: a handover waiting for an agent to accept it.

for_customers.title: For Customers
for_customers.description: Customers can pick it in the portal and the web form.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The whole new list: add, remove, rename or reorder fields.

for_customers.title: For Customers
for_customers.description: false hides it from the portal and the web form.

name.title: Name
name.description: One of: Refund / return, Billing, Delivery, App problem

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Each of the four topics once, with its keywords. null: back to the built-in lists. A ticket with none of the words is "General question".

redact_cards.title: Redact Cards
redact_cards.description: Remove card numbers from customer messages before saving. Removed numbers can't be brought back.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: In tie order: on a tie the first one wins.

general_topic.title: General Topic
general_topic.description: The topic when no keyword matches.

visitor.title: Visitor
visitor.description: A random id the page keeps for this browser (e.g. a UUID in localStorage). One vote per visitor per article; voting again changes it.
